name: NROL-136
destination_explanation: Even at this height there are faint wisps of atmosphere. They slowly drag satellites down, so anything here needs an occasional push to stay up.
slot_a_text: B1097 has flown thirteen times in thirteen months. The mix: eight Starlink, one NROL, one Transporter, and three others. At its fastest it was back on the pad in 14 days.
slot_b_text: SLC-4E is up to 72 launches this year, and 309 since its first in 1964. Its previous launch was only a day earlier.
